HU.title: Zooming Into 7 Worlds That Could Be Like Earth Take a cinematic journey through 7 fascinating worlds beyond our Solar System as we zoom in and explore what these distant exoplanets might look like up close. From potentially Earth-like worlds to planets orbiting some of our nearest stellar neighbors, each one offers a different glimpse into the incredible diversity of planets beyond our Solar System. In this journey, we explore: KOI-4878.01 Kepler-22b Proxima Centauri b Kepler-186f TRAPPIST-1e Proxima Centauri d Kepler-1638b These worlds are incredibly distant, and their true appearances remain largely unknown.
